children: Corvex entered into an At-the-Market Sales Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets to offer and sell shares of common stock from time to time. Sales may be made as at-the-market offerings under Rule 415, with Corvex paying a 2.5% commission on gross proceeds and certain capped legal reimbursements. The company is not obligated to sell any shares and may suspend the program at any time. Net proceeds are intended for working capital and general corporate purposes.
